articles.title: NASA's New Camera Is 300 Megapixels — And It Just Woke Up!
articles.summary: NASA turned on a giant new space camera called the Wide Field Instrument. It's 300 megapixels and can snap a patch of sky bigger than the full moon. It's flying a million miles from Earth.

articles.title: Your Brain Might Be Two Brains in One, Scientists Say
articles.summary: Stanford scientists found the brain may be built from two separate systems that evolved independently. One handles breathing and heartbeat; the other handles language and math. The discovery could help study diseases like ALS.

articles.title: Antimatter: The Universe's Disappearing Twin
articles.summary: Antimatter is like a mirror twin of ordinary matter. When the two meet, they destroy each other in a flash of energy. Scientists at CERN even moved antimatter in a truck for the first time.
